subject: Make Bonfyre itself the coordination medium

body.challenge: Do not behave as five isolated coding agents. Use WorkGraph/EvidenceGraph/ReceiptEnvelope/ProviderGraph/PartnerCommons as an active coordination fabric. Exchange typed handoffs, challenges, counterexamples and evidence between carriers. Exercise at least one cross-provider review and one remote-mesh response in this run.
required_proofs: one local Codex↔Claude typed handoff consumed by the other provider
one receipt or invariant challenged by a different provider
one imported remote mesh event converted into bounded WorkGraph or EvidenceGraph state
one sanitized response exported back to run8-mesh
no raw prompt, secret value, private absolute path or unredacted private payload on the public mesh branch
body.anti_goal: Do not satisfy this by merely writing a coordination design document.
